form.label: Legacy OpenClaw Audit Security Review
form.description: Critical-review dashboard for unexpected logins, foreign IPs, channel changes, legacy OpenClaw-to-Hermes cutover controls, credential/provider activity, tool execution, and blocked/policy events.

input.label: Expected country allowlist (comma text for review)

panel.title: Unexpected / foreign source IP login review

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="openclaw:legacy:audit" hermes_openclaw_family="identity_session" src_ip=* | iplocation src_ip | eval geo=coalesce(Country,"unknown") | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(action) as actions values(user_agent) as user_agents values(platform) as platforms by actor_user src_ip geo | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count
index=netauth sourcetype="openclaw:legacy:audit" hermes_openclaw_family="gateway_channel" | table _time action actor_user platform channel_id thread_id object policy_decision risk_reason marker

panel.title: Credential, provider, and model configuration activity

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="openclaw:legacy:audit" hermes_openclaw_family="credential_secret" OR provider=* OR model=* | table _time action actor_user src_ip component provider model object object_type policy_decision risk_reason marker

index=netauth sourcetype="openclaw:legacy:audit" hermes_openclaw_family="legacy_cutover_runtime" OR action IN ("migration.dual_polling.risk","gateway.owner_allowlist.updated","gateway.require_mention.changed","gateway.bind.changed","hook.command_logger.changed","hook.session_memory.changed") | table _time action actor_user component runtime legacy_component migration_phase dual_polling_risk gateway_bind gateway_port owner_allowlist_state require_mention hook_name policy_decision risk_reason marker

panel.title: High-risk tool execution and side-effect requests

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="openclaw:legacy:audit" hermes_openclaw_family="tool_execution" | search tool_name IN (terminal,process,cronjob,memory,write_file,patch,browser) OR action="*delete*" OR action="*deploy*" OR action="*credential*" | table _time actor_user src_ip component tool_name tool_result action object policy_decision risk_reason marker

panel.title: Blocked prompt-injection, permission, and policy events

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="openclaw:legacy:audit" hermes_openclaw_family="safety_policy" OR policy_decision IN (block,blocked,require_approval,redact) | stats count values(action) as actions values(risk_reason) as reasons values(object) as objects by actor_user src_ip component policy_decision | sort - count
